newsitem.title: USA: Food Court hires Furman Selz as advisor.
newsitem.headline: Food Court hires Furman Selz as advisor.

text.p: Food Court Entertainment Network Inc said on Thursday it hired Furman Selz LLC to provide financial advisory and investment banking services, as part of its growth and development efforts.

President and Chief Executive Officer James Perkins said Furman Selz would assist the firm in strategic development and provide counsel on prospective acquisitions, capital market transactions and related activities.
Food Court produces and distributes Cafe USA, a shopper's entertainment and information television network seen in food courts of major regional malls.
